title: Dimensional Ladder: φ, π, and Triad Exponents Are Lattice-Native
summary: Shows that the triad operator T(a,b,c) = φ^a + π^b + φ^c is entirely lattice-native. φ emerges from the self-similar scaling structure (r²=r+1 → r=φ, verified with Q128.128 fixed-point arithmetic). π emerges from the S^n spherical geometry of the propagation graph (Vol(S¹)=2π, Vol(S³)=2π², Vol(S⁵)=π³, Vol(S⁷)=π⁴/3). The exponents (5,2,-4) for the hydrogen 21cm line are dimensional signatures from the path S⁵→N³→S⁷, not fitted parameters. The generative equations (6 consistent equations) constrain the exponent assignments. This closes the triad operator gap.

lattice_native_constants.phi: Self-similar scaling: r²=r+1 → r=φ. Emerges from 15-layer reversal symmetry, 7-defect structure, self-referential shell transition 16³=15³+3(240)+1
lattice_native_constants.pi: S^n sphere volumes: Vol(S¹)=2π, Vol(S³)=2π², Vol(S⁵)=π³, Vol(S⁷)=π⁴/3. Emerges from the spherical components of the propagation graph

hydrogen_21cm.derivation: a=5 (S⁵ dimension), b=2 (N³ transition: 3-1=2), c=-4 (closure defect: -(H→O Cayley-Dickson gain)= -4)

generative_equations: 6 consistent equations: p1+p2=p4, p1+p3=p5, p3+p4=p6, p1+p6=p7, p2+p5=p6, p4+p5=p7. 7th equation (p2+p3=p7) is inconsistent with the other 6 (as noted in x.md).
gap_closed: Triad operator T(a,b,c): φ, π, and exponents are all lattice-native (was gap #7, now closed)
